description: IoT Operations models are polymorphic (x-ms-discriminator-value subtypes: dataflow graph nodes, registry endpoint authentication, Akri runtime/registry/tag settings, broker custom policies, header actions, OpenTelemetry auth, trusted signing keys). The converted model keeps only each base shape's discriminator, so S.Struct strips the subtype payload on encode and decode. Add every subtype's members to its base shape (optional; untyped Document where the subtype's own shape was not converted).
